d: Donald Trump won the White House in 2024. But can he keep control of Congress in 2026? America is heading into the midterm elections, and the stakes are enormous. All 435 seats in the House and 35 Senate seats are up for grabs. Polls suggest Democrats have momentum, while Trump's approval ratings and concerns over the cost of living are weighing on Republicans. So, is America heading for a political power shift? And how much could it change Trump's presidency? Palki Sharma tells you.
